scope: Actual isolated Docker runc on the existing Linux preparation host; no production API changes, no downloads during tasks, not a container escape proof.

checks.name: Nim range sum
checks.code:
var total = 0
for n in 1..10:
  total += n
echo total

checks.name: Nim object and sequtils
checks.code:
import std/sequtils
type Box = object
  value:int
let values = @[Box(value:3),Box(value:4),Box(value:5)]
echo values.mapIt(it.value).foldl(a+b)

result.compilerStderr: /work/main.nim(2, 13) Error: type mismatch: got 'string' for '"wrong"' but expected 'int'

result.stderr:
/work/main.nim(1)        main
Error: unhandled exception: intentional error [ValueError]
